newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: White House denies Clinton travelling with golf pro.
newsitem.headline: White House denies Clinton travelling with golf pro.

text.p: A report in an Australian newspaper that visiting U.S. president Bill Clinton was travelling with a golf pro had White House officials scratching their heads on Wednesday.
"There is no golf pro on the airplane," White House spokesman David Johnson said.
"I've spoken to everyone on the plane who plays golf and they were amused and bemused that there would be any allegation that they were the president's golf pro," he said.
The Sydney Morning Herald, quoting Australian government officials, reported that a golf pro was among hundreds of staff accompanying Clinton on a nine-day visit to Australia and Asia.

Clinton, a keen golfer, is expected to tee off with world number one, Australian Greg Norman, in Sydney on Thursday. There is also a chance the president will play a round with rising U.S. star Tiger Woods, who is also in Sydney for a tournament.
